name: Mizuhana Hinare
source:
She is a black gal-like heroine who is kind to otaku. She uses "ashi" to address herself.

She and Makoto have known each other since childhood, and they have even been able to exchange casual banter. Unlike Makoto, she has a sociable personality and is close to everyone.

She is the type of person who can easily talk to anyone regardless of gender, and even if Makoto doesn't talk to her at all, she will often get involved with him on her own. 

She has a very voluptuous body and enjoys teasing Makoto by giving him glimpses of her panties, thighs, cleavage, etc., to get a reaction.

She often performs small acts of kindness, such as taking the hand of a lost child to look for its parents or taking it to a service counter.

[From [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/105gyaru/#character]official site[/url]]
